title: Why Do Volcanoes Actually Erupt?
description:
Volcanoes are not leaks from a sea of liquid fire. Rising magma, trapped gas and falling pressure make the bubbles that blast it out.

#volcano #science #geology #shorts

beats.sentence: Deep down, rock is mostly solid, but in places a little melts into magma.

beats.sentence: That magma is lighter than the rock around it, so it rises into a chamber.

beats.sentence: Dissolved gas, mostly water vapour and carbon dioxide, is trapped inside.

beats.sentence: As the magma climbs, the pressure drops, and the gas forms bubbles.

beats.sentence: The bubbles grow, and they push the magma upward faster.
beats.subject: volcano

beats.sentence: It is like a shaken fizzy drink.

beats.sentence: The pressure finally breaks the rock plug in the crater.

beats.sentence: Lava, ash and gas blast out into the air.

beats.sentence: Thick, sticky magma traps gas longer, so the blast is bigger.

beats.sentence: Runny magma lets gas escape, so lava just flows down the slopes.

beats.sentence: Over millions of years, this gas probably helped build our air and oceans.
